title: Asking a Question — Three Ways, and Which One to Use
label: ch:fr-questions
canDo: I can ask a question in French three ways — by raising my voice, with est-ce que, and by inversion — choose between them by how formal the moment is, and ask where, when, how, how much and why.

payoff.summary: The one question word that agrees with its noun, closing a chapter that began with the question costing no new words at all.
